text:
alex: quick idea — prototyping a tiny CLI helper (working name: skein) that 'stitches' together deploy-bot commands + release-note boilerplate + automated pin/rollback hints. goal: one command to produce a copy-paste ready rollout snippet and optionally run a dry deploy.

marie: ok can you show a sample flow? sounds like it might reduce copy/paste for oncall.

alex: sure — sketch:
```
# skein create --service api --target=canary --version=2026.03.21-rc3 --change-window="2026-03-22 09:00-11:00"\n# outputs: deploy-bot command + release note + pin command + quick rollback snippet
```
It would also include a lint pass that checks pin compatibility (e.g. not pinning older major) and warns if change-window overlaps other pinned rollouts.

kai: I like linting. can skein call our internal release note template? we often forget to add migration notes.

alex: yes — skein would read a small template file in repo: .release_templates/deploy_note.md and fill placeholders. Example output: 
```
@deploy-bot deploy --service api --env staging --version 2026.03.21-rc3 --pin=sha:abcd1234 --change-window="2026-03-22T09:00Z/2026-03-22T11:00Z" --dry-run
--- release-note ---\nRollout: api 2026.03.21-rc3\nWhy: perf fixes for prefix caching\nMigration: none\nRollback plan: /deploy-bot rollback --service api --to=2026.03.20\n--- end ---
```
Also outputs a short 'rollback hint' block that recommends which routes to watch and a simple metric query.

deploy-bot: queued: dry-run validation started for api@2026.03.21-rc3 (this is a simulated bot msg to show what skein would get back)

sam: can skein do canary split suggestions? like suggest 5/20/100 based on past release ramp durations?

alex: MVP: static presets (quick: 10/30/60, conservative: 5/20/100). Future: pull rollout speed from previous rollouts stored in Console. I'd rather avoid ML for now.

jess: ops-sre: what's the plan for permissions? we don't want everyone pinning prod accidentally.

ops-sre: skein should generate the command but not execute by default. Add a `--execute` flag that requires an additional confirmation and checks ACL via the existing release-gate service. Also record a short audit note in the rollout metadata.

alex: agreed. default is `--dry-run` and a textarea prompt with the release-note draft. We add `--execute --confirm` which will call release-gate and then send the final /deploy-bot command.

marie: could skein also create the release note PR? that would save the chore of copying text into GH.

kai: yes make it opt-in: `skein create --pr` and it will open a draft PR using our release-notes bot token. the PR body uses the template and includes links to the canary dashboard tiles.

sam: error handling: if deploy-bot responds with a pinned-version-mismatch, skein should parse and suggest `--force-pin` with explanation. but log a step that needs approver if forced.

alex: plan for files in repo: 
- bin/skein (small Go binary)
- .release_templates/deploy_note.md
- ops/skein-presets.yaml (canary profiles)
- scripts/convert-pin.sh (helper to format pin strings)

jess: can we add a 'brief' output that managers can paste into status channels? something like a 2-line summary + link to PR/dashboard.

alex: yes default output prints both 'full' (for engineers) and 'brief' (for status). brief example: `api: 2026.03.21-rc3 => canary 10% (09:00-11:00 UTC). PR: <link> Dash: <link>`.

deploy-bot: dry-run result: validation ok, no route collisions detected.

ops-sre: two concerns: 1) change-window collisions across teams; skein should query calendar or our scheduled-rollouts DB and warn. 2) timezones — always print both local and UTC.

alex: noted. I'll add a calendar-check step and timezone display. also plan to add a `skein audit` command that dumps the generated commands to a standard audit log (we already have one for release-gate).

marie: timeline? can we have a prototype for the next release week?

alex: yes aiming for a rough prototype by EOD Friday. I'll open a draft RFC in eng-releases for feedback and a short demo.

sam: :thumbsup: please include an escape hatch template for immediate hotfix rollbacks (one-liner rollback + status channel blurb).

alex: will do. example hotfix rollback brief:
```
/deploy-bot rollback --service api --to=2026.03.20 --reason="hotfix: revert rc3"\nStatus update: api hotfix rollback issued by @alex — monitoring: latency, error-rate. Dash: <link>
```

jess: sweet. thanks alex — excited to try it.

alex: thanks all, will post RFC + link to prototype binary here once ready. :rocket:
